{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Mochew City |characters=ウイロウシティ |japanese=Uirō City |image=Mochew City.png |imagesize=250px |region=Johto |epicode=HZ094 |episode=The Pokémon Center Lady |colorscheme=ZA }} '''Mochew City''' (Japanese: '''ウイロウシティ''' ''Uirō City'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location located in [[Johto]]. It is the [[hometown]] of [[Mollie]], whose family operates the local [[Pokémon Center]]. It is located not far from [[Blackthorn City]]. Mollie returned to working at her family's Pokémon Center alongside [[Mollie's mother|her mother]] after the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] disbanded. [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and their Pokémon ended up here over a year later and were reunited with Mollie in ''[[HZ094|The Pokémon Center Lady]]''. The city is known for its signature breakfast special. [[Team Dragon Rampage]] mentioned a health spa opening here in ''[[HZ096|Crash! Team Dragon Rampage!]]''. [[Woody Park]] and the [[Exceed Testing Center]] are located nearby. ==Gallery== File:Mochew City Pokémon Center.png|Mochew City's [[Pokémon Center]] File:Mochew City hotel.png|A hotel in Mochew City File:Mochew City breakfast special.png|Mochew City's signature breakfast special ==Trivia== * In BBC iPlayer captions, Mochew City was misspelled as ''Mossui City'' and ''Mocha City''. ===Origin=== The signature breakfast special of Mochew City may be inspired by the breakfast culture of {{wp|Nagoya}} as part of its morning service. The dish that appeared in the anime resembles {{wp|Ogura toast}}, which features thick-cut toasted milk bread served with {{wp|adzuki bean}} paste, butter, and whipped cream.
